title: Ring of Fire Sunflower - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Rare Variety
description:
Stunning Bicolour Blooms for Late Summer Drama - AAS & Fleuroselect Winner!


KEY FEATURES
• Award-winning bicolour blooms with a unique 'solar eclipse' effect
• Branching habit produces multiple flowers per plant for an extended display
• Pollenless variety, perfect for long-lasting cut flowers (10-14 day vase life)
• Late-season bloomer, providing vibrant colour from August to October
• Attracts pollinators and adds dramatic flair to any garden or border


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Other Plants — Helianthus annuus 'Ring of Fire'
Colour: Bicolour: deep mahogany-red ring, golden-yellow petal tips, dark chocolate-brown disc
Season: August - October (100-120 days from sowing)
Growth Habit: Branching


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun (6-10+ hours direct)
Soil: Well-drained, moderately fertile soil (pH 6.0-7.5)
Watering: Deep, infrequent watering (approx. 2.5 cm per week) once established
Spacing: 45cm apart
Height: 120-150cm
Spread: Dependent on branching, typically 45-60cm
Hardiness: Half-Hardy Annual (UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out in late May-June after all risk of frost has passed, ensuring the soil is warm.
• Choose a sheltered spot in full sun to protect from strong winds, especially for taller plants.
• Water regularly during dry spells, focusing on deep watering to encourage strong root development.
• Consider providing support in exposed positions as the plants grow tall and heavy with blooms.
• Feed with a potassium-rich fertiliser (like tomato feed) once established to encourage prolific flowering.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
